coverage: Initial verified selection, not complete Warsaw coverage. PIK music/theatre/exhibition pages and municipal calendars were partially reviewed first, then official venue programmes, public Telegram announcements and chat previews. Some calendar indexes linked to stale or conflicting details; those were held. Source pagination and late-November breadth remain incomplete. Exhibitions are real ranges, not daily sessions. No fresh Telegram event imported; Instagram/Threads not checked.
